mapper.select: SELECT b.id, b.title, b.author, b.price, b.publish_date, b.description, b.category_id, c.name AS category_name, b.total_stock, b.available_stock, b.version FROM book b LEFT JOIN category c ON b.category_id = c.id ORDER BY b.id DESC

SELECT b.id, b.title, b.author, b.price, b.publish_date, b.description, b.category_id, c.name AS category_name, b.total_stock, b.available_stock, b.version FROM book b LEFT JOIN category c ON b.category_id = c.id WHERE b.category_id IS NULL ORDER BY b.id DESC

SELECT b.id, b.title, b.author, b.price, b.publish_date, b.description, b.category_id, c.name AS category_name, b.total_stock, b.available_stock, b.version FROM book b LEFT JOIN category c ON b.category_id = c.id WHERE b.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO book (title, author, price, publish_date, description, category_id, total_stock, available_stock) VALUES (#{title}, #{author}, #{price}, #{publishDate}, #{description}, #{categoryId}, #{totalStock}, #{availableStock})
mapper.update: UPDATE book SET title = #{title}, author = #{author}, price = #{price}, publish_date = #{publishDate}, description = #{description}, category_id = #{categoryId}, total_stock = #{totalStock}, available_stock = #{availableStock} WHERE id = #{id}
